sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports the insight card parts
sections.what: Brings in the icons, the card and badge building blocks, and the store that holds the app's data.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are needed to draw the card and read the data it summarizes.

sections.name: AIInsightsWidget (part 1)
sections.title: Calculates the three summary facts
sections.what: Works out the percent of completed tasks, adds focus minutes into whole hours, and counts pending assignments. Writes a sentence and badge for each fact, with a fallback sentence when there is no data yet.
sections.why: Likely reason: turns raw numbers into readable sentences in one place. Reason for the fallback wording not stated.
sections.watch_out: Focus time is rounded to whole hours, so less than 30 minutes shows as zero hours.

sections.name: AIInsightsWidget (part 2)
sections.title: Draws the three insight cards
sections.what: Lays out the three facts side by side on wide screens and stacks them on narrow screens. Each card shows its title, its badge and its sentence.
sections.why: Likely reason: a repeated layout so the three facts look consistent.
sections.watch_out: Badge colours come from named variants, so any new variant name must exist in the Badge component.

summary: A card that shows three simple summary facts about the user's tasks, focus time and assignments.
purpose: Gives a quick snapshot of how the user is doing, based on counts from the app's own data.
why: Likely reason: a fast summary built from data already in the app. The code calls it a heuristic, meaning a simple rule of thumb rather than a learned model.
how: Reads tasks, focus sessions and assignments from the store. Works out the percent of completed tasks, the total focus time in whole hours, and the number of pending assignments. Writes a sentence and a badge for each. The deadline badge turns to a warning when any assignment is pending.
inputs: Tasks, focus sessions and assignments from the store.
outputs: Three cards in a row: task completion, focus hours and deadline risk. Each has a title, a badge and a short sentence. Nothing is saved.
risks: Focus time is rounded to whole hours, so less than 30 minutes shows as zero. The task percentage counts all tasks ever created, not a chosen time period. The label REAL-TIME SYNTHESIS suggests live analysis, but the code only counts stored data.
debug: If a number looks wrong, check the filters: completed status for tasks, pending status for assignments, and the duration values in focus sessions. If the cards do not change, check whether the store is updating those lists.
